scenes.caption: A case.
scenes.say: Detective Zara has a case. Someone has misspelt a word.

scenes.caption: A silent letter.
scenes.say: The word is knee. The k is silent, but it must stay.

scenes.caption: Homophones.
scenes.say: Allowed and aloud sound alike but mean different things.

scenes.caption: Plurals.
scenes.say: Baby becomes babies. A city becomes cities.

scenes.caption: Prefixes.
scenes.say: Kind becomes unkind. Possible becomes impossible.

scenes.caption: Suffixes.
scenes.say: Quick becomes quickly. Sun becomes sunny.

scenes.caption: Strategy.
scenes.say: Look, cover, write, check. That is the detective's method.

scenes.caption: Solved.
scenes.say: Case closed. Every word is spelt right!
